app.name: D2 Agent Assistant
app.tagline: Your 11pm answer, powered by D2 knowledge

auth.signInDescription: Sign in with your D2 Google account to access your AI coaching assistant.
auth.unauthorised: You don't have access. Contact your senior coach.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

chat.placeholder: Ask anything about D2 properties, SOPs, or your onboarding journey…
chat.emptyState: Hi! I'm your D2 Agent Assistant. Ask me anything about D2 properties, onboarding steps, or sales SOPs.
chat.rateLimit: You've reached your hourly limit. Please wait a few minutes.
chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

disclosure.title: This assistant uses AI
disclosure.body: D2 Agent Assistant is powered by AI. While it provides answers grounded in D2 training materials, always verify important information with your senior coach. Your conversations may be reviewed to improve the service.

chat.talkToCoachError: Could not reach your coach. Please try again.

handoff.kbMiss: I couldn't find a D2 knowledge base article for this. Your senior coach has been notified.
handoff.escalated: This has been escalated to your senior coach.
handoff.stall: You haven't completed this onboarding step yet. Your coach has been alerted.
